text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
I took a look at the training.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
It'd be unrefined of me to meddle
in every little detail, though.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
That girl still has room to grow.
She can reach even higher.

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha!
Fired up is good, but
don't wear such a stiff face!

text_block_list.name: Hoshina Keiko
text_block_list.text:
Take a breather and keep at it.
I'll be watching from right here too.
